**STEP 1 - Scene:** A breakfast-style meal, photographed from above with the image rotated about 90°. The plate holds a brown porridge-like dish topped with banana slices and a few red bits, mashed potato, pan-fried potato cubes, a fried egg, and a piece of toast under the egg.

**STEP 2 - Ruler:** A square white dinner plate, about 26 cm across. Area = 3.14 × (13)² ≈ 530 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** (1) brown porridge with red bits, (2) banana slices, (3) mashed potato, (4) pan-fried potato cubes, (5) fried egg, (6) toast, (7) one stray potato cube. No visible oil pool or sauce.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Porridge ~10% (53 cm²), banana ~1% (5 cm²), mashed potato ~12% (64 cm²), potato cubes ~14% (74 cm²), egg ~10% (53 cm²), toast ~8% (42 cm²), stray cube ~1% (5 cm²). Total ≈ 56% of the plate is covered, which is consistent with the photo.

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Porridge 53 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 80 ml. Banana ≈ 5 ml. Mashed potato 64 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 96 ml. Potato cubes 74 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 89 ml. Egg 53 cm² × 1 cm ≈ 53 ml. Toast 42 cm² × 1 cm ≈ 42 ml. Stray cube ≈ 6 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Porridge 80 × 0.9 ≈ 72 g. Banana 5 × 1.0 ≈ 5 g. Mashed potato 96 × 0.9 ≈ 86 g. Potato cubes (89 × 0.6) + 4 g stray ≈ 57 g. Egg 53 × 0.95 ≈ 50 g. Toast 42 × 0.9 ≈ 38 g. Total ≈ 308 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Porridge 72 g × 70 kcal/100 g ≈ 50 kcal. Banana 5 g × 89 ≈ 4 kcal. Mashed potato 86 g × 100 ≈ 86 kcal. Potato cubes 57 g × 150 ≈ 86 kcal. Egg 50 g × 196 ≈ 98 kcal. Toast 38 g × 265 ≈ 101 kcal. Total ≈ 425 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 300 g and roughly 425 kcal fits a plate that is about half covered with a moderate breakfast portion. The porridge and potato values are the least certain, since the brown base could be a different grain.
